description: Default UK target locations for this fork's portal-search skills and /scrape. This is the single source of truth for which cities the fork searches. Portal CLIs default to `defaults` below when their --location/-l flag is omitted; passing --location always overrides these. Each portal maps a city's `name`/`aliases` onto its own location parameter (Adzuna `where=`, Reed `locationName=`, LinkedIn geo, etc.). NOTE (Artem's fork): defaults trimmed to London + remote-UK — Manchester, Glasgow and Edinburgh are out of scope for this search, so querying them only slows sweeps. Re-add to `defaults` to widen.

edinburgh.name: Edinburgh
edinburgh.note: Not in `defaults` by default. Add "edinburgh" to the defaults array to include it in every search.
